description: This file defines the InsideViewLogicHook class which provides methods for generating InsideView URLs for different CRM entities such as Account, Opportunity, Lead, and Contact, and displaying an embedded frame within the CRM interface. It contains URL construction logic, field mapping, and view rendering functionalities specific to the InsideView integration module.

classes.name: InsideViewLogicHook
classes.description: A class that handles generating InsideView URLs for different CRM entities and displays embedded InsideView frames within the CRM interface.

methods.name: handleFieldMap
methods.description: Maps fields from a bean based on a provided mapping and creates a URL-encoded query string.

methods.name: getAccountFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for the Account entity with relevant account data.

methods.name: getOpportunityFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for the Opportunity entity with relevant opportunity data.

methods.name: getLeadFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for the Lead entity with relevant lead data.

methods.name: getContactFrameUrl
methods.description: Constructs the InsideView URL for the Contact entity with relevant contact data.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Main function to determine if the InsideView frame should be displayed, generates the URL based on bean type, and renders the embedded frame using Smarty template.
